control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - change assurance not applied to P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4102, ACC-4102 and M-4102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 15 April 2026 a planned assurance activity of P-4102, ACC-4102 and M-4102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the secondary containment by bund and drainage not effective.
